presentation.bestHand: Four aces and the joker: the best hand of the game.
presentation.intro: A deck of four aces, four kings, four queens, four jacks and a joker, which stands for any card. Ten hands to take the chips of the other player.

points.checked: Once the game is over, every key is shown: each participant checks that no card was dealt unfairly.
points.hidden: Only you can read your cards: the other player gives you their keys to them, you keep yours.
points.shuffle: Each hand, the two players shuffle a new deck in turn, encrypted: no one, not even the server, knows its order.

presentation.rooms: Create a room or join an open one: the participants without a seat watch the game.
presentation.tagline: Poker for two players, with 17 cards and no dealer.
presentation.title: Seventeen poker

deck.cards: 17 cards: the aces, kings, queens and jacks of the four suits, and a joker, which stands for the card giving the best hand. A new deck is shuffled for each hand.
deck.title: The deck

fair.dealer: The players shuffle each deck together, encrypted, and give each other the keys of the cards dealt: no one, not even the server, sees a hand before its showdown. At the end of the match, every key is shown and each participant checks every deck.
fair.title: No dealer

hand.ante: Each player pays an ante of 5 chips, and gets 5 cards.
hand.away: While a player is away, the move gets 30 more seconds, once: the player to act, still away when the time is up, loses the match.
hand.clock: Each move lasts 45 seconds at most: once the time is up, the player checks, folds against a bet, or keeps the hand in the exchange.
hand.exchange: Exchange: each player in turn discards cards and draws as many; the second one draws from the cards left.
hand.firstRound: First round: check, bet, raise, call or fold. When both players check, the antes go to the bank.
hand.secondRound: Second round: a bet is at least the one of the first round, and 30 chips at most.
hand.showdown: Showdown: the best hand takes the pot. A player who folds leaves it to the other one.
hand.title: A hand

hands.fiveOfAKind: Five of a kind: the four cards of a rank and the joker.
hands.fourOfAKind: Four of a kind: four cards of a rank.
hands.fullHouse: Full house: three cards of a rank and two of another.
hands.onePair: One pair: two cards of a rank. Every hand holds one at least.
hands.royalFlush: Royal flush: the jack, queen, king and ace of a suit, the joker as the ten.
hands.straight: Straight: a jack, a queen, a king and an ace, the joker as the ten.
hands.threeOfAKind: Three of a kind: three cards of a rank.
hands.ties: Between hands of the same kind, the higher ranks win, the ace first; a hand without the joker beats the same hand with it. Only equal hands split the pot.
hands.title: The hands, from the best
hands.twoPair: Two pair: two cards of a rank and two of another.

match.cap: In a hand, no one bets more chips than the poorer player has.
match.end: 10 hands, 150 chips each: the player with the most chips wins. The match ends sooner when a player can no longer pay the ante.
match.title: The match

status.myTurnEnding: Your turn: time is running out.
